title: Coding Journey for Beginners
description: A structured plan to start your coding journey with consistent practice and project building

goals.title: Learn Programming Fundamentals
goals.description: Complete a beginner programming course (Python or JavaScript)

goals.title: Build First Project
goals.description: Complete your first functional project (calculator, to-do list, etc.)

goals.title: Practice Daily
goals.description: Code for at least 30 minutes every day

habits.title: Daily Coding Practice
habits.description: Code for at least 30 minutes every day

habits.title: Learn New Concept
habits.description: Learn one new programming concept each week

habits.title: Review Code
habits.description: Review and refactor previous code for better practices

tasks.title: Choose Programming Language
tasks.description: Decide between Python, JavaScript, or another language

tasks.title: Set Up Development Environment
tasks.description: Install code editor and necessary tools

tasks.title: Complete First Tutorial
tasks.description: Follow a beginner tutorial to write your first program

tasks.title: Join Coding Community
tasks.description: Join Discord, Reddit, or Stack Overflow for help

tasks.title: Create GitHub Account
tasks.description: Set up GitHub for version control and portfolio

tasks.title: Plan First Project
tasks.description: Outline your first project idea and features

warnings: Don't rush through tutorials - focus on understanding
Ask for help when stuck - coding is collaborative
Build projects, don't just watch tutorials
fallback_message: I found a great coding template for beginners! Let me set you up with a structured plan to start your programming journey.
